scope: Final read-only accounting diagnostic of both frozen conditions and archived invalid preparation; frozen instruments/apps unchanged; no API/key/account/subscription reads; no quality or speed winner.

single.unreported_usage_policy: Unknown, not zero; do not extrapolate missing usage. Last reported cumulative counters exclude any unreported consumption.
single.proxy_status: Only arithmetic for observed reported tokens under frozen hypothetical rates; not complete run spend, invoice, or subscription usage.

collector_diagnostic.authoritative_total_withholding: Correct: timed out phase has no CLI completion counters or required fresh auditor.
collector_diagnostic.observed_tokens_all_zero: Artifact of reconciliation, not evidence of no usage. reconcile_phases adds root only after CLI counter validation; failure leaves roots empty, so collect never extracts the stopped root and sums an empty model list.
collector_diagnostic.recommended_reporting_only: Preserve tokens=null and tokens_complete=false. Separately disclose last_reported_partial_counters from native_after, confirmed by owned native log. Do not change frozen instruments for this comparison.
collector_diagnostic.adaptive_observed_subset: Completed builder root including repair + backend child + completed auditor1 retained, but stopped auditor2 excluded by missing CLI completion counters. Full totals/prices correctly withheld; disclosed known observations need auditor2 reported partial counters separately.

interrupted_schema_rejected_preparation.classification: Instrument-invalid attempt; disclose as preparation, exclude from accepted app comparison; not assumed zero.
interrupted_schema_rejected_preparation.rejected_audit_usage_policy: 400 invalid_json_schema response before independent model review has no authoritative usage counters. task_complete marker does not prove model accounting completeness. Unknown, not zero.

clock.basis: run.py records time.time timestamps and time.monotonic elapsed. Parent supplies intentional interruption/host pause context. These records alone do not isolate pause duration from clock adjustment or identify CPU/model-active time. Runner elapsed is measured monotonic duration, not equivalent to calendar wall time or necessarily active compute. Preserve both clocks; do not rank speed.

token_partitions: Cached input is a subset of input; ordinary input = input-cached when reported cache-write count is zero. Reasoning is a subset of output; total=input+output. Never add cached or reasoning tokens to total or charge reasoning again. Reported zero cache-write is an observed counter, not inference of all possible billing details.

price_basis.status: Parent independently reread official Standard pricing table on 2026-10-13 and saved proof that frozen short/long sol and luna rows match. These remain conditional API equivalents, not actual native billed or subscription cost.
price_basis.exclusions: Image generation, other tool charges, shared setup/native preflight, final scoring, publication, invalid preparation and unknown unreported consumption are not represented in per-run complete spend.

root_declared_selection_evidence: Runtime advertised model catalog and reasoning efforts
backend_child_model_selection.root_declared_rationale: Critical auth and transactional state justify workhorse; lowest-cost model in dated catalog judged qualified for this coupled security outcome. One independent coherent backend outcome overlaps frontend work.
backend_child_model_selection.rationale_status: Builder judgment recorded in native tool call that wrote ROUTING.json. It is not independent evidence that cheaper models could not satisfy the task.
backend_child_model_selection.capability_evidence: Native collaboration declaration advertised gpt-6-luna and supported model/effort overrides for fresh scoped spawns. The actual spawn explicitly supplied sol rather than inheriting a hidden default. No examined native evidence says cheaper model selection was unavailable or rejected.
backend_child_model_selection.disclosed_limitation: Builder recorded primary exact model identifier not exposed to builder. This does not explain or restrict explicit child model override; actual native contexts show primary sol/high.
backend_child_model_selection.price_interpretation: Medium effort changes reasoning configuration, not the frozen per-token sol API unit rates. This run did not test cheaper-model backend implementation. Bugs and fixes cannot be attributed to cheap models.

cost_composition_observations.interpretation: Known adaptive costs come entirely from observed sol tokens, including builder repairs, one helper and two auditor observations. High cache fractions are input subsets charged at cached rates; output includes reasoning. Higher observed subset spend than stopped single cannot establish efficiency or quality because completion/stages and unknown consumption differ.
cost_composition_observations.preparation_policy: Archived invalid completed-builder proxy $1.2726912 kept separately; rejected request and full preparation unknown. Never fold preparation into one accepted condition or assume it is free.
